snippet.title: Ape‑tite — Early Trailer - EN #CookingGorilla #Apetite
snippet.description:
Early trailer for Ape‑tite, an in‑development indie game by Ki‑nodes Studio.
This trailer presents an early look at the game’s direction, tone, and gameplay as development continues.

Ape‑tite is a cooking game focused on shared space, complex recipes, and the small mistakes that cascade when kitchens get crowded. It can be played solo or with friends in local co‑op.

🛠️ Status: Early development
🎮 Players: Solo or local co‑op (1–4 players)  
🧠 Focus: Spatial pressure, coordination, and recovery  

👉 Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553490/Apetite/  
👉 Studio: Ki‑nodes Studio  

Feedback is welcome — this project is still evolving.  

#indiedev #indiegames #coopgame #cookinggame #gorilla #ゴリラ
